title: First Exodus patent and a possible national security hold

tellings.quote:
Some patents apparently go through the
Department of Defense.

plain: A NASA engineer named Charles Buhler says the first patent for his company Exodus Propulsion's thruster may have been caught up in a national security review. He points to the Invention Secrecy Act of 1952, a US law that lets the government keep some inventions secret, and says "some patents apparently go through the Department of Defense," which would mean the military takes an interest in this kind of technology.
